description_en: Queries whiteboard document information under a specified AppID by paging
description_zh: 分页查询某AppID下的白板文档信息
name: DescribeWhiteBoards

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the whiteboard application. To obtain the AppID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204234.html
parameters.help_zh: 白板文档唯一标识符。获取AppID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204234.html
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the whiteboard document. If this parameter is left empty, all statuses are queried by default. Valid values:

- **1**: Enabled.
- **2**: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
白板文档状态，参数为空默认查询所有状态。取值：

- **1**：启用。
- **2**：停用
parameters.name: doc_status

parameters.help_en: The page number. If this parameter is left empty, the first page is queried by default
parameters.help_zh: 查询页码，参数为空默认查询第1页
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. If this parameter is left empty, the default value is 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示个数，参数为空默认显示个数为10
parameters.name: page_size
